newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Atok falls in late trade on par value change.
newsitem.headline: Atok falls in late trade on par value change.

text.p: Philippine holding firm Atok Big Wedge Co dropped 74 centavos, or 29.84 percent, to 1.74 pesos in late trade on Friday on news that par value of its shares would be changed, brokers said.

"It's sell on the news since the change will be reflected in the exchange's computer system on Monday. We saw buying on the issue prior to approval of the change," said Elline Salvatierra, analyst at Dharmala Securities.
The Securities and Exchange Commission recently approved the change in the par value of Atok shares from 0.01 peso to 1.0 peso.
Atok was one of the top ten actively traded issue on Friday.
